purpose: Passive canonical identity and structural segmentation map for every raw SKILL.md path in the pinned AgentSkillExchange manifest. Segments are structural content classes, NOT grades or eligibility decisions.

identity_verification.method: Nontruncated clone of the exact pin; git ls-tree -r -t compared with every manifest [path, blob, tree] entry (external host, not repository tooling)

segment_definitions.catalog-stub-no-procedure: Only Prerequisites/Installation/Documentation/Source sections and the Installation text states that no source-backed install or usage instructions could be extracted automatically; description-only catalog card
segment_definitions.catalog-card-install-pointer: Only Prerequisites/Installation/Documentation/Source sections with auto-extracted upstream install/usage fragments; a pointer card, not an authored procedure
segment_definitions.authored-procedure: Contains authored sections beyond the catalog template (workflow, safety, usage, etc.)

segment_paths.catalog-card-install-pointer: all remaining direct-shape manifest paths (2,651); derive by subtraction from the manifest parts

other_shape_classification.class: nested first-class reference skill inside docsbot-administration package
nested first-class reference skill inside docsbot-administration package
nested first-class reference skill inside docsbot-administration package
NOT-A-SKILL: contributor authoring template with placeholder values (name "Your Skill Name", example upstream); excluded from any eligible-skill denominator; no grade assigned

exact_content_duplicate_exposures.basis: SKILL.md identical after removing slug line, self-referential catalog URL and star/download counters; blobs differ only in those identifiers
SKILL.md identical after removing slug line, self-referential catalog URL and star/download counters; blobs differ only in those identifiers
SKILL.md identical after removing slug line, self-referential catalog URL and star/download counters; blobs differ only in those identifiers

same_name_distinct_content_pairs.finding: different descriptions/framework claims over the same upstream; near-duplicate exposure, separately reviewable

shared_upstream_source_groups.finding: Many cards are synthetic capability names wrapped around the same generic upstream repository (e.g. 29 cards cite hashicorp/terraform, 28 aws/aws-sdk-js-v3). Shared upstream is NOT proof of semantic duplication; each card is reviewed individually, but upstream-level facts may be shared.

publisher_verification_labels.status: publisher assertions only; no package in this snapshot ships review evidence supporting security_reviewed

denominator_note: Structural upper bound for independent first-class package identities in this source is 3,199 (3,200 minus the template), minus 3 exact content duplicate exposures = 3,196 content-distinct paths. Whether catalog stubs/pointer cards count as eligible skills is a governance question; they remain individually reviewable and are not excluded here.
